name: ActivitySheet
intent: The app shell's activity panel as an ordinary right-hand Sheet: two tabbed streams behind one surface — transient notifications you dismiss, and a changeset of edits that accumulate until applied or discarded — rendered with standard cards and buttons rather than a bespoke translucent surface. Reuses NotificationCenter's NotificationItem and ChangeEntry types so a shell can feed both from the state it already keeps.
when: A top-bar bell and/or changeset button that should open a normal side panel
Notifications and pending edits that belong behind one surface with tabs, not two separate panels
An activity panel that must sit visually flush with the rest of the shell
whenNot: A translucent overlay panel with its own visual language -> use NotificationCenter
A single transient message -> use Toast / Sonner

chooseOver.because: NotificationCenter renders its own bespoke translucent surface. ActivitySheet is a plain Sheet with standard cards and buttons, so it matches the rest of the shell instead of competing with it.

stubPlan: dataContract: stub — author input fields, slots, rowIdentity
configSchema: stub — enumerate config props from source

extracted: the NotificationItem and ChangeEntry shapes, reused verbatim
the two-stream model (notifications + changeset) and its actions

notes: Promoted out of the Core Connect V3 template so any shell can use it, rather than staying template-local
